verification_limit: Two DOI sources add six new initial textile sample-state pairs and ten ordinary TG records, with zero evidence upgrades and zero legacy completions. Complete native scientific bodies of both primary HTML originals and all ten pages of the UHMWPE primary PDF were reviewed, including seven primary tables, all thirteen figure captions and the UHMWPE SI index. Four official PEDOT:PSS cotton tables supply four same-formulation fabric LOI means18.5/18.5/29.0/28.5, with raw uncertainties retained without assuming SD/SE or replicate counts; ordinary TG is air and N2 at20Cmin30-800C. T5 and decomposition DTG remain separate. The CPPE N2 R800 table14.35 versus prose14.5 conflict is excluded from every canonical residue field, while unambiguous T5_198/DTG324 remain. Source contradictory direction statements do not replace explicit numeric values. Stock-solution mass, recipe feed percentages and claimed PEDOT:PSS surface content have different bases; no retained coating composition is invented. The undoped CPP formulation has no own TG or LOI and remains held. The UHMWPE PDFp7 Fig4 caption explicitly assigns both LOI and TG to fabrics, so fiber880dtex is not joined to fabric442dtex. Ownp8 untreated fabric LOI17.5/Tmax482.8 and gAPP-coated hydroxylated fabric LOI22.9/Tmax497.8 in N2 at10Cmin are approved. The conflicting reported19C Tmax increment is retained as a source anomaly and excluded; no inferred absolute peak is substituted. Char5.49/52.6 has no explicit endpoint and stays auxiliary, with all canonical residue and endpoint fields blank. The microcalorimeter30-700C range is not an ordinary TG range or residue endpoint. Raw fabric areal-weight unit180gcm2 is not silently corrected; canonical gm2 remains blank. LOI GB/T5454-1997 is explicit for UHMWPE; unknown assay-specific geometry, replicates and conditioning stay blank. Four additional UHMWPE formulations remain held for absent own LOI, absent numerical TG or curve-only TG. Abrasion, washing and bending performance are not cloned into new TG-LOI pairs. Linked UHMWPE DOCX access returned403 and its full content is unreviewed; adequate primary captions and numeric evidence support only the two initial pairs. Five held fact rows, two unbound char values and one conflicting cotton R800 metric are excluded. All215 independent scientific guards and thirteen source regression tests pass. Seventy-five whole-canonical comparisons retain three explicitly adjudicated single-metric coincidences,17 baseline presentations, zero full paired-profile matches and zero unresolved hits. CPPE DTG324 coincides only after discarding T5_198, while the other recipes have different or absent LOI18.5 and T5_198. UHMWPE untreated and held hydroxylated fabric explicitly share the author-reported Tmax482.8, but only untreated fabric has an own numeric LOI. This is not a copied complete sample profile. Three read-only library originals, four official primary table files and seven private native evidence files remain hash-bound. Public content is factual data, concise DOI/page/table/caption evidence, necessary tests and validation results; no fulltexts, images, private paths or private annotations are published.
